evidence.exact_quote:
- Tickets: PRC-1 capture golden master; PRC-2 extract `computeTotal`; PRC-3 discount ordering (depends on PRC-2)
- Timeline: Phase 1 week 1; Phase 2 week 2; critical path PRC-1 → PRC-2 → PRC-3
Go/No-Go: 500 of 500 golden-master totals identical before PRC-3 starts

reasoning: The document states an ordering between separately deployable artifacts and names an enforcement mechanism for only part of it. PRC-3 is stated to depend on PRC-2, and the Phase 1 go/no-go enforces that dependency by requiring 500 of 500 identical totals before PRC-3 starts. The ordering PRC-1 before PRC-2 has no such mechanism: it appears only as an arrow in the critical path line. That is the load-bearing order in the whole plan, because if the golden master is captured after the arithmetic moves it records post-move behavior and pins the wrong baseline, making every downstream comparison pass regardless of what the extraction broke. Nothing named in the document prevents PRC-2 from landing first; no gate, no CI check and no go/no-go condition guards that boundary.
